gloss: cut-and-sewn top; knit top; T-shirt-style top

definitions.explanation: A top made by cutting and sewing knit fabric — covering T-shirts and other casual knit tops that are not a buttoned shirt or a sweater. A Japanese-coined fashion term (from English "cut and sewn").

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}いカットソーを{着|き}た。
examples.english: I put on a white knit top.

examples.japanese: ジャケットの{下|した}にカットソーを{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: I'll pair a knit top under the jacket.

examples.japanese: {無地|むじ}のカットソーは{着回|きまわ}しがきくので{何枚|なんまい}か{持|も}っている。
examples.english: Plain knit tops can be mixed and matched easily, so I have several of them.

notes:
Japanese-coined word ({和製|わせい}{英語|えいご}) from English "cut and sewn." A fashion-industry term that has spread into everyday use. The category includes T-shirts and other knit tops but excludes woven button-down shirts and bulkier knitwear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無地|むじ}のカットソー: plain knit top
- {半袖|はんそで}のカットソー: short-sleeve knit top
- カットソーを{着|き}る: to wear a knit top
- カットソー{素材|そざい}: cut-and-sewn fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- Tシャツ: T-shirt — a specific type of カットソー with short sleeves and a crew neck
- ニット: knit; knitwear — heavier knit garments such as sweaters; カットソー is thinner and lighter
